replication.target_description: VABS Composite change over baseline and three annual assessments, EIBI versus SAU; age-adjusted linear mixed-model time-by-treatment interaction (difference in slopes).

n.sample_role: Repeated-measure observations in the VABS Composite model, as printed in Table 3; not a count of independent children.
n.exclusions: Study enrolled 94 children (48 EIBI,46 SAU). Intention-to-treat analyses use available longitudinal data. Two EIBI children lost to follow-up; five SAU families declined Year 3 testing. Outcome-specific counts retained exactly as Table 3 prints them.
